after_record.statement: For Q(n,m), m>=2, suppose each long map has fixed injective routing of source polynomial columns to target outer coordinates and arbitrary regular m-by-m channel matrices. Let N count the product of covered source first indices, G the corresponding product from invertible leading channel blocks, and c the product of connected-component counts of good full-window source-column positions, with edges at distance<m.
